references.text: Abraham again says that Sarah is his sister, which leads to her being taken into King Abimelech's house.
Abraham explains to Abimelech that he feared for his life and that Sarah is actually his half-sister, and that they agreed she should call him her brother wherever they went.
Isaac repeats his father's action by saying that Rebekah is his sister to protect himself.
God punished kings on account of the patriarchs and warned them not to touch His anointed—this includes the episodes where Abraham and Isaac were in danger among foreign kings.
